title: Surface area.
officialText:
The glass in glass elevator car doors shall be not less than 60 percent of the total visible door panel surface
area as seen from the car side of the doors.
SECTION BC 2410
MARKING OF TRANSPARENT DOORS AND
FIXED ADJACENT TRANSPARENT SIDELIGHTS
